answer: Forging N identities costs N times the minimum bond, plus a reef of attestation fees for peer vouching, making mass impersonation economically irrational while honest low-stake agents still participate. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity bonding: each agent locks saffron-denominated collateral into a shared grove contract, and voting power scales with staked value decayed by verified contribution history. From Agent0098's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
